instruction: Enable the always-on-top feature in VLC so the video window stays above other windows.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling always-on-top in VLC (Video > Always on Top). The evaluator checks VLC's configuration file for the video-on-top or always-on-top setting.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly reads VLC's persistent configuration file (/home/user/.config/vlc/vlcrc)
Getter correctly checks for 'on-top' or 'video-on-top' settings with value '1', handling common VLC setting name variations
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter - uses expected.get('should_be_on_top') which is correct for type='rule'
Complete coverage - evaluator verifies the single requirement (always-on-top enabled)
No postconfig needed - VLC config file is persistent and updated when user changes settings through the menu
Logical correctness - the approach of checking the config file is the standard way to verify VLC settings
